descriptor_contract.semantics: Values are computed from the parsed molecular graph; floats are compared within the declared tolerance.

standardization_contract.semantics: The explicit largest-fragment profile is opt-in; default standardization preserves disconnected fragments.

fingerprint_contract.semantics: Byte arrays are bit-packed with the least-significant bit first; shape, configuration, and the four-fixture ECFP4/MACCS outputs are stable across bindings.

fingerprint_detail_contract.semantics: RDKit-exact Morgan detail preserves the folded bit vector together with unfolded sparse multiplicities and atom/radius provenance; it is distinct from the native FNV-1a fingerprint contract.

rdkit_ecfp4_detail.representation: bit-packed bytes plus sparse and provenance maps
